meaning:
ἀγνωσία, -ας, ἡ
(γινώσκω), [in LXX: Job.35:16 (בִּבְלִי־דַּעַת), Wis.13:1, 3Ma.5:27 * ;]
ignorance (opposite to γνῶσις): 1Co.15:34, 1Pe.2:15 (see Hort in l.; MM, VGT, see word).†

elsewhere.note: Wake up righteously, and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.
For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:
